# Bundled Autodesk FBX SDK

- Version: 2020.3.11, Windows VS2022 x64
- Source: locally installed Autodesk FBX SDK 2020.3.11
- License: original Autodesk License.rtf retained here

Includes the SDK headers and dynamic-link import libraries/runtime DLLs for
Debug and Release. The editor uses Debug files for Debug and Release files for
Release/Shipping. Runtime/Game do not link this SDK.

Static libraries, samples, installer and uninstaller are excluded.
No external SDK installation or FBX_SDK_ROOT environment variable is required.
